				local _ = v32.ExchangeAmount
				v_u_20.UpdateShopFrames()
			end
			v_u_20.SelectObject(true)
			return
		end
	end
	local v39
	if v33 == "Weapons" or (v33 == "Pets" or (v33 == "MysteryBox" or (v33 == "Eggs" or v33 == "Item"))) then
		v39 = false
	elseif v_u_2[v33].Owned[p28] then
		v39 = true
	else
		for _, v40 in v_u_2[v33].Owned do
			if v40 ~= p28 then
				continue
			end
			v39 = true
		end
		v39 = false
	end
	if v39 then
		v_u_20.SelectObject()
	elseif p30 == "Gems" and v34.Gems ~= nil then
		v_u_20.SelectObject()
		v_u_20.ViewGems(v34.Gems - v_u_2.Gems)
	end
end

function v_u_20.SelectItemToPurchase(p62, p63, p64, p65, p66)
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_1
	v_u_6.DisplayItem(p62.ItemFrame.ItemContainer, p64)
	p62.Description.Visible = p66.Description ~= nil and true or p64.Description ~= nil
	p62.Description.TextLabel.Text = p66.Description or (p64.Description or "")
	p62.BuyTitle.Visible = true
	local v67
	if p65 == "Weapons" or (p65 == "Pets" or (p65 == "MysteryBox" or (p65 == "Eggs" or p65 == "Item"))) then
		v67 = false
	elseif v_u_2[p65].Owned[p63] then
		v67 = true
	else
		for _, v68 in v_u_2[p65].Owned do
			if v68 ~= p63 then
				continue
			end
			v67 = true
		end
		v67 = false
	end
	for _, v69 in pairs(p62.PriceFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if v_u_1.Currencies[v69.Name] == nil then
			continue
		end
		local v70 = v69.Name
		v69.Visible = p66.Price[v70] ~= nil
		v69.Container.PriceFrame.PriceLabel.Text = p66.Price[v70] and (v_u_6.Commafy(p66.Price[v70]) or "") or ""
		v69.Buy.Style = (v67 or v70 == "Coins" and (p66.Price.Coins ~= nil and v_u_2.Coins < p66.Price.Coins)) and Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundButton or Enum.ButtonStyle.RobloxRoundDefaultButton
	end
	p62.PriceFrame.BuyTitle.Title.Text = v67 and "OWNED" or "Buy It Now!"
	local v71 = p62.PriceFrame.GetMoreGems
	local v72
	if p66.Price.Gems == nil or p66.Price.Coins ~= nil then
		v72 = false
	else
		v72 = v_u_2.Gems < (p66.Price and p66.Price.Gems or 0)
	end
	v71.Visible = v72
end

function v_u_20.UpdateShopFrames()
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_79, (copy) v_u_2
	for v102, v103 in pairs(v_u_79) do
		if v102 == "Weapons" or v102 == "Pets" then
			continue
		end
		for v104, v105 in pairs(v103) do
			local v106
			if v102 == "Weapons" or (v102 == "Pets" or (v102 == "MysteryBox" or (v102 == "Eggs" or v102 == "Item"))) then
				v106 = false
			elseif v_u_2[v102].Owned[v104] then
				v106 = true
			else
				for _, v107 in v_u_2[v102].Owned do
					if v107 ~= v104 then
						continue
					end
					v106 = true
				end
				v106 = false
			end
			if not v106 then
				continue
			end
			for _, v108 in pairs(v105.Frame.Tags:GetChildren()) do
				if not v108:IsA("Frame") then
					continue
				end
				v108.Visible = v108.Name == "Owned"
			end
		end
	end
end

		local v17

local function v_u_45() -- name: GetSortedItemList
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_1, (copy) v_u_12
	local v21 = {}
	for v22, v23 in v_u_9 do
		if not v_u_4:FindItemInfo(v22, v23.Type) then
			continue
		end
		local v24 = {
			["ID"] = v22,
			["Info"] = v_u_4:GetItemInfo(v22, v23.Type),
			["Shop"] = v23
		}
		table.insert(v21, v24)
	end
	table.sort(v21, function(p25, p26)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (ref) v_u_12
		local v27 = p25.ID
		local v28 = p25.Info
		local v29 = p25.Shop
		local v30 = p26.ID
		local v31 = p26.Info
		local v32 = p26.Shop
		local v33 = v28.Rarity or "Common"
		local v34 = v31.Rarity or "Common"
		local v35 = v_u_1:ItemAlreadyPurchased(v27)
		if v35 == v_u_1:ItemAlreadyPurchased(v30) then
			if v29.Limited and not v32.Limited then
				return true
			elseif v32.Limited and not v29.Limited then
				return false
			else
				if v33 == v34 then
					local v36 = v29.Price.Coins ~= nil
					local v37 = v32.Price.Coins ~= nil
					if v36 and v37 then
						if v29.Price.Coins ~= v32.Price.Coins then
							return v29.Price.Coins < v32.Price.Coins
						end
					elseif v36 ~= v37 then
						return v36
					end
					local v38 = v29.Price.Gems ~= nil
					local v39 = v32.Price.Gems ~= nil
					if v38 and v39 then
						if v29.Price.Gems ~= v32.Price.Gems then
							return v29.Price.Gems < v32.Price.Gems
						end
					elseif v38 ~= v39 then
						return v38
					end
				end
				local v40 = v_u_12[v33] or 0
				local v41 = v_u_12[v34] or 0
				if v40 == v41 then
					return v27 < v30
				else
					return v41 < v40
				end
			end
		else
			return not v35
		end
	end)
	local v42 = {}
	for _, v43 in v21 do
		local v44 = v43.ID
		table.insert(v42, v44)
	end
	return v42
end
function v_u_1.PurchaseIsRepeatable(_, p46) -- name: PurchaseIsRepeatable
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_14
	local v47 = v_u_9[p46]
	local v48 = v47.Type
	if v47.OneTimePurchase then
		return false
	else
		return v47.DevProductId and not v47.OneTimePurchase and true or ((v_u_14[v48] or (v48 == "MysteryBox" or v48 == "Eggs")) and true or false)
	end
end
function v_u_1.HasRequiredPurchases(_, p49) -- name: HasRequiredPurchases
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_5
	local v50 = v_u_9[p49]
	if not v50.RequiredPurchases then
		return true
	end
	local v51 = 0
	local v52 = 0
	for _, v53 in v50.RequiredPurchases do
		if v_u_5.OneTimePurchases[v53] then
			v51 = v51 + 1
		end
		v52 = v52 + 1
	end
	return v52 <= v51
end
function v_u_1.ItemAlreadyPurchased(_, p54) -- name: ItemAlreadyPurchased
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_9, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_14
	local v55 = v_u_9[p54]
	local v56 = v55.Type
	if v55.DevProductId then
		local v57
		if v55.OneTimePurchase == true then
			v57 = v_u_5.OneTimePurchases[p54] == true
		else
			v57 = false
		end
		return v57
	elseif v55.GamepassId and v_u_5.OneTimePurchases[p54] == true then
		return true
	elseif v_u_14[v56] or (v56 == "MysteryBox" or v56 == "Eggs") then
		return false
	elseif v_u_5[v56] then
		return table.find(v_u_5[v56].Owned, p54) ~= nil
	else
		return false
	end
end
